desc: The Rock Island Armory Baby Rock Flat Dark Earth 380 ACP is scaled down version of the 1911 in a 380acp. The Baby Rock weighs in it just 1.62lbs loaded, all the controls are are exactly like a 1911. Made from carbon steel with a Flat Dark Earth cerakote finish. It comes equipped with low profile anti snag dovetailed sights, comfortable grip safety, and rubber checkered grips. Whether you are looking to scale down your full sized 1911 into something easier for concealed carry, or something manageable with not too much recoil for home defense, the Baby Rock may be the right choice for you.
